name: primitive-intersected-with-object-types
description: A value whose type is a primitive intersected with object types is the primitive at runtime, so it carries none of the members the object types declare. A test file's runner-called export that converts a value holding such types to unknown reaches each member of the plain object types the value holds, which is then a test reference, and none of the members of an object type a string, a number or a boolean is intersected with, written inline or named, held through a union, an array, a property and a map. Those members nothing references are reported as unused at certain, the same as where no test reaches them.
